description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveEntitlementSummaryModel class, which represents a data model for leave entitlement summaries within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin API. It implements serialization and normalization functionality, constructs data representations from LeaveEntitlement entities, and includes OpenAPI schema annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementSummaryModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing leave entitlement summary data, including entitlement breakdown, leave type info, and date range.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a LeaveEntitlement entity and prepares it for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Generates an array representation of the leave entitlement summary, including detailed balance info and leave type.
